transforms.name: adapter-step-0
transforms.effect: permission.requested emits interaction:permission-requested with presentation native-tui. tool is permissionRequest.kind or promptRequest.kind.

transforms.name: adapter-step-1
transforms.effect: permission.completed lowercases result.kind, else approval.kind. den or reject becomes denied. allow or approv becomes allowed. dismiss or cancel becomes dismissed. Any other non-empty or empty string becomes unknown.

transforms.name: adapter-step-2
transforms.effect: A completed record with no requestId emits nothing.
